description: 阅读理解：基于项目内容的选择题，检验理解程度

questions.question: What is this project about?
questions.questionCn: 这个项目是关于什么的？
questions.explanation: 项目名称是 A better me，主题是「成为更好的自己」。

questions.question: What is one of Jack's good habits?

options.label: B
options.text: He spends too much time on his phone.
options.textCn: 他在手机上花太多时间。

options.label: C
options.text: He is honest and always tells the truth.

questions.explanation: Jack说：I'm honest. I always tell the truth. 我很诚实，我总是说实话。这是他的好习惯之一。

questions.question: What is one of Jack's bad habits?

options.label: A
options.text: He gets up early every day.

options.label: C
options.text: He spends too much time on his phone.
options.textCn: 他在手机上花太多时间。

options.label: D
options.text: He is never late for school.

questions.explanation: Jack说：Sometimes I spend too much time on my phone. 有时候我在手机上花太多时间。这是他的坏习惯之一。

questions.question: What is Jack afraid of?

options.label: B
options.text: He is afraid of speaking in public.
options.textCn: 他害怕在公共场合讲话。

options.label: C
options.text: He is afraid of the dark.

questions.explanation: Jack说：I'm afraid of speaking in public. 我害怕在公共场合讲话。

questions.question: How many parts are there in Jack's plan?
questions.explanation: Jack的计划分为三部分：First... Second... Third... 第一、第二、第三。

questions.question: What is the first thing in Jack's plan?
questions.questionCn: Jack计划的第一件事是什么？

options.label: B
options.text: He will join the speech club.

options.label: C
options.text: He will limit his screen time to one hour a day.
options.textCn: 他要把屏幕时间限制在每天一小时。

questions.explanation: First, I will limit my screen time to one hour a day. 第一，我要把屏幕时间限制在每天一小时。

questions.question: Why will Jack join the school speech club?
questions.questionCn: Jack为什么要加入学校演讲俱乐部？

options.label: B
options.text: Because he wants to become braver.

options.label: C
options.text: Because he wants to make more friends.

options.label: D
options.text: Because his parents ask him to.

questions.explanation: Third, I will join the school speech club to become braver. 第三，我要加入学校演讲俱乐部来变得更勇敢。

questions.question: How can we become better according to Jack?
questions.questionCn: 根据Jack的说法，我们怎样才能变得更好？
questions.explanation: We can become better by being honest and hard-working. 我们可以通过诚实和勤奋变得更好。

questions.question: What does "Small changes can make a big difference." mean?
questions.questionCn: 「Small changes can make a big difference.」是什么意思？

options.label: B
options.text: Even small changes can have a big effect.
options.textCn: 即使是小改变也能产生大影响。

options.label: C
options.text: We need to make big changes only.

questions.explanation: make a difference 是固定短语，意思是「有影响；有作用」。这句话的意思是：小小的改变也能带来大大的不同/大影响。

questions.question: What does Jack do in the show part?

options.label: B
options.text: He shares his plan for becoming a better me.
options.textCn: 他分享了他成为更好的自己的计划。

questions.explanation: I'd like to share my plan for becoming a better me. 我想分享我成为更好的自己的计划。这是成果展示环节。

questions.question: What does Jack say at the end of his speech?
questions.explanation: Thank you for listening! 谢谢你们的聆听！这是演讲结尾的常用表达。

questions.question: What does "I believe I can make it." mean?
questions.questionCn: 「I believe I can make it.」是什么意思？
questions.explanation: make it 是固定短语，意思是「成功做到；成功」，不是「制作它」。I believe I can make it. = 我相信我能做到/成功。

questions.question: What are the three stages of this project?
questions.questionCn: 这个项目的三个阶段是什么？

options.label: B
options.text: Know yourself, Plan for yourself, Show yourself.
options.textCn: 自我认知、自我规划、成果展示。

questions.explanation: 项目分为三个阶段：Know yourself（自我认知）→ Plan for yourself（自我规划）→ Show yourself（成果展示）。

questions.question: Which units does Project 1 integrate?
questions.questionCn: Project 1 整合了哪几个单元的知识？
questions.explanation: Project 1 A better me 整合了前四单元（Unit 1-Unit 4）的内容：Try your best、Honesty、Great people、Getting together。

questions.question: What is the main idea of this project?
questions.questionCn: 这个项目的主旨是什么？

options.label: B
options.text: We should know ourselves and try to become better every day.
options.textCn: 我们应该认识自己，努力每天变得更好。

options.label: D
options.text: We should spend more time on phones.
options.textCn: 我们应该花更多时间在手机上。

questions.explanation: 项目主题是 A better me（更好的自己），通过自我认知、自我规划和成果展示，鼓励学生认识自己的优缺点，制定改进计划，努力成为更好的自己。
